AgentEvaluation.description: An agent's reading of a finished benchmark. These are judgements, not expert review; each finding should name a deterministic check that would confirm it, so objections are tested against the data.
AgentEvaluation.title: AgentEvaluation

proposed_check.description: A deterministic test that would confirm or refute the finding.

sources.description: Every external input, pinned by release and checksum.

BenchmarkItem.description: One protein with its target annotations.

difficulty.description: The hardest difficulty among the item's targets.

entry_name.description: UniProtKB entry name (mnemonic), used in the FASTA header.

BenchmarkItem.title: BenchmarkItem

BenchmarkSpec.description: The request a benchmark is built from. Everything the builder needs is here, so the spec plus its pinned sources reproduce the benchmark.

aspects.description: Aspects to draw targets from; all three if omitted.

baseline_release.description: GO release date (YYYY-MM-DD) used as the pre-cutoff snapshot. Must be on or before cutoff_date.

conditions.description: The evaluation conditions a run compares per item, for example a sequence-only blind read against an agent reasoning over sequence, knowledge and context. A condition says what a predictor may see, not which predictor is run.

current_release.description: GO release date (YYYY-MM-DD) the target annotations are drawn from. Must be after cutoff_date.

cutoff_date.description: Knowledge cutoff. The baseline release must be on or before this date; annotations absent from it are candidates.

decoys_per_item.description: Decoy terms per item: terms drawn from other items' targets that are not entailed by, and do not entail, any current annotation of the protein. They measure a predictor's tendency to say yes.

dev_fraction.description: Fraction of items assigned to the DEV split (seeded); the rest are TEST.

evidence_codes.description: Evidence codes that qualify a target. Defaults to the CAFA experimental set EXP IDA IPI IMP IGI IEP TAS IC.

excluded_terms.description: Terms never used as targets. Defaults to the aspect roots, binding and protein binding.

go_branches.description: Optional GO ids; when given, a target term must be the id or a descendant (is_a/part_of) of one of them.

id.description: Short benchmark identifier, used for the folder and file names.

include_negated.description: Also take NOT annotations as (negative) targets.

max_proteins_per_reference.description: A reference that adds new annotations to more proteins than this is treated as high-throughput and its rows are not used as targets.

min_reference_date.description: Optional. Keep only targets whose PubMed reference was published on or after this date (targets with non-PMID references are dropped).

near_duplicate_threshold.description: Lin similarity at or above which a target counts as a near-duplicate of a baseline term.

predictors.description: Predictors planned for or run on this benchmark. Optional; listed so the reference_recency check can compare target dates with each predictor's training cutoff before any run.

seed.description: Random seed for sampling and split assignment.

size.description: Number of items (proteins) to draw, including feature quotas.

BenchmarkSpec.title: BenchmarkSpec

mean_information_content.description: Mean IC (bits, from baseline annotation frequencies) of target terms.

top_reference_share.description: Fraction of targets that come from the most frequent reference.

CheckReport.description: Results of the deterministic checks over one benchmark.
CheckReport.title: CheckReport

CheckResult.description: One check on one target annotation, item, or the whole benchmark.

evidence.description: Rows or values the result rests on, for example a baseline GAF row.

CheckResult.title: CheckResult

info.description: INFO results, including checks that could not be performed.

Claim.description: One question a predictor is asked: does the protein of this item have this GO term? A claim never says whether its term is a target, a NOT target or a decoy.

sequence_id.description: Id of the item's record in the exported FASTA.

Claim.title: Claim

ClaimSet.description: The claims exported for a benchmark, written as <id>-claims.yaml.
ClaimSet.title: ClaimSet

ConditionScore.description: Verdict counts for one condition and predictor (and, in item_scores, one item) and one query role.

n_missing.description: Queries with no verdict (not asked, failed, or null).

ConditionScore.title: ConditionScore

DecoyTerm.description: A term the protein is not annotated to, used as a negative control. Absence of an annotation is not a measurement that the protein lacks the function, so a yes on a decoy is not necessarily wrong.

drawn_from.description: Item whose target supplied the term.

DecoyTerm.title: DecoyTerm

EvaluationCondition.description: What a predictor is allowed to see about each item. Conditions differ in what the predictor is shown, so comparing them per item separates reading the sequence from recalling or retrieving knowledge about the named protein. Any predictor can be run under any condition it supports.

shuffle_control.description: Also ask of a shuffled copy of each sequence (predictions marked sequence_control SHUFFLED), to measure yes answers that do not depend on the sequence.

EvaluationCondition.title: EvaluationCondition

FeatureQuota.description: Request that some items carry a feature, such as being a pseudoenzyme. Candidates come from a UniProt query; the label is UniProt's, not a literature check, and is recorded as such.

count.description: Maximum number of items with this feature.

min_reference_date.description: Overrides the spec's min_reference_date for this quota, for features too rare to fill from the main window.

uniprot_query.description: UniProtKB query whose hits are the feature's candidate proteins.

FeatureQuota.title: FeatureQuota

literature_checked.description: True only when someone read the literature behind the label. A UniProt name containing "inactive" is not a literature check.

source.description: Where the label came from, for example the UniProt query that matched.

KnowledgeCategoryEnum.description: CAFA knowledge categories, judged at the baseline release on experimental evidence.
KnowledgeCategoryEnum.title: KnowledgeCategoryEnum

Prediction.description: One predictor's answer to one claim under one condition. This is the only format `benchmark score` reads; importers convert each predictor's native output into it. A prediction names its claim by claim_id or by item_id plus term.

claim_id.description: Id of the Claim answered; optional when term is given.

condition.description: Name of an EvaluationCondition in the spec.

confidence.description: The predictor's stated confidence in its verdict, 0 to 1.

context.description: The condition's context level, for records read without the spec.

evidence.description: The predictor's stated reasoning or evidence, verbatim or abridged.

provenance.description: Where the record came from, for example the native output file and record id.

score.description: A numeric score for the claim, for predictors that give one (a probability, an E-value-derived score). Scored as a verdict only with an explicit threshold.

sequence_control.description: Whether the native or a shuffled sequence was shown (default NATIVE).

term.description: GO term id the prediction is about; optional when claim_id is given.

verdict.description: The predictor's answer; absent when it gave none.

Prediction.title: Prediction

PredictionSet.description: A YAML file of predictions. JSONL files hold one Prediction per line instead, and are validated as a PredictionSet without a benchmark_id.
PredictionSet.title: PredictionSet

Predictor.description: A configured predictor: a tool, model or person, with the settings that change its answers. Two runs of one tool with different models are different predictors.

effort.description: Reasoning effort or thinking level, in the provider's own labels.

model.description: Underlying model, when the predictor is a model or uses one.

model_training_cutoff.description: Training data cutoff of the model. Targets whose reference predates it may be known to the model from the literature, whatever the GO release dates say.

name.description: Predictor name as Prediction records give it, for example peptalk:claude-opus-5-5, interproscan, ai-gene-review:claude-opus-5-5 or a curator's ORCID.

Predictor.title: Predictor

ScoreReport.description: Verdicts of each predictor under each condition on each item's targets, NOT targets and decoys, tallied overall and per item so conditions and predictors can be compared item by item.

inputs.description: Prediction files scored, each with its sha256.

ScoreReport.title: ScoreReport

SourceSnapshot.description: One pinned input file or query.

name.description: Role of the source, for example baseline_gaf or current_ontology.

query.description: For a query source, the query string.

release.description: Release identifier (GO release date, UniProt release).

SourceSnapshot.title: SourceSnapshot

TargetAnnotation.description: An annotation a predictor should recover (or, if negated, should not assert).

gaf_date.description: The GAF date column (YYYYMMDD). GO re-stamps it, so it is not proof of newness.

reference_date.description: PubMed publication date (sortpubdate) of the reference. The builder picks the earliest-published supporting reference as the target's reference, since that is when the knowledge became readable. The record date can be later than a preprint of the same work.

review_action.description: Action an ai-gene-review review gave this annotation, when one exists.

supporting_references.description: Every reference in the current release supporting this term on this protein (including reference), when there is more than one.

TargetAnnotation.title: TargetAnnotation

gaf_code.description: Species code used in GO release file names (HUMAN for annotations/gaf/HUMAN-uniprot.gaf.gz; goa_human in older releases).

sources.description: Every external input, pinned by release and checksum.
